games.title: Summit
games.tagline: Four friends. One mountain. No way down but up.
games.description: A four-player co-op climb from a jungle shoreline to a volcanic caldera. Stamina is everything: every hold you take drains it, every ledge you haul a friend over costs you both. Weather turns, hunger bites, and the route is generated fresh from a seed every run. Rope up, ration the food, and get everyone to the extraction helicopter at the peak.
games.controls: WASD · Mouse look · Space · Shift · Trackpad friendly

games.title: Voxel
games.tagline: Break it, stack it, build the thing in your head.
games.description: An open voxel sandbox: procedurally generated biomes, caves and structures, mineable blocks, crafting and mobs. Build until the sun goes down, then keep building.
games.controls: WASD · Mouse look · Left click break · Right click place · E inventory

games.title: Bonecrown
games.tagline: Take the crown. Keep it if you can.
games.description: A dark action crawl through bone halls. Fight, loot, and push deeper — the crown makes you stronger and everything in the dark angrier.
games.controls: WASD · Mouse to aim · Click to attack

games.title: Neon Bay
games.tagline: An open city, a fast car, and no particular plan.
games.description: Drive, get out, walk around, cause trouble. An open-world sandbox city with traffic, pedestrians and a day cycle — built to mess about in.
games.controls: WASD drive · F enter/exit · Mouse look · Shift sprint

games.title: Neon Drift
games.description: A synth-lit endless descent. Weave the barriers, bank the corners, and chain near-misses to keep your boost meter alive. Speed climbs forever; the track never repeats.

games.title: Vector Siege
games.tagline: Hold the line against the geometry.
games.description: Twin-stick wave defence rendered in pure vectors. Waves escalate, weapons stack, and the arena tightens. Survive twenty waves without losing the core.
games.controls: WASD to move · Mouse to aim · Click to fire

games.title: Lumen
games.tagline: Stack the light. Clear the dark.
games.description: A falling-block puzzle about colour and patience. Match three shades to fuse them into light, chain fusions for cascades, and hold the board back as the drop speed tightens.
games.controls: ←/→ to move · ↓ to drop · Z/X to rotate

games.title: Schedule I
games.tagline: Build the operation. Don't get caught.
games.description: A top-down business sim of routes, risk and reputation. Manage supply, keep the phone quiet, expand the territory, and read the heat before it reads you.
games.controls: WASD to move · E to interact · Tab for phone
